Name: Anime HD Xtardew Portraits
Author: Beornwahl
Description:
[b][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/Hz8VrWZ.png[/img][/size][/b]

Finally it's here! The Anime HD Xtardew Valley mod! Experience Diego's great mod with an anime twist!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nz4TVjt.png[/img]
The mod comes with 'proof of concept' sex scene art for Leah. If someone figures out how to use it for the the repeat scenes in Xtardew I'll be ready to make them for the remaining characters.

Otherwise this ends my mod series Anime HD. I have no plans for further additions but can instead refer to the talented modders already advancing the work - most noticeable Supersony2689's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15671]HD Anime portraits for Ridgeside Village[/url]. 

I myself am going om modding vacation:
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RDGkmfC.png[/img]
(also known as going back to my real job...)
Take care! <3[/center]
[b][size=3][b][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/Cd7YvSK.png[/img][size=3][b]
Make sure you have the following mods installed in advance:

[size=3]1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits [/url]
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - StardewModding API [/url][/size][/b][/size]
[size=3][b][size=3]3. [/size][/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399][size=3][b][size=3]Xtardew Valley[/size][/b][/size][/url]

[b][size=3]Hereafter download the main file, copy the unzipped folder named Anime HD Xtardew Portraits to your Mods folder
[b][size=3]
Now, this mod comes with a redone Caroline version, which you can overwrite in my Anime HD mod should you have it.

I was also unable to figure out how to load the Haley Polaroid photo (maybe Darklich will show me how again one day!), so you'll have to overwrite that yourself in the Xtardew folder. See Installation file for more.

[b]Quick FAQ:[/b]

- Will you do seasonal portraits?
- As mentioned on the main mod it is simply too overwhelming a task. So sadly, no.

- Are these AI-generated?
- Yes they are. Unstable Diffusion with Anything v3.
